stabilityMethod: Availability is the share of time in a running state among the periods with container data. HTTP is not checked. Containers are sampled once a minute, and a percentage appears after 30 minutes of observations. Gaps are not counted. When the last observation is older than 90 seconds, the state is shown as unknown.
